mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/8dab1848f9d0-t1/tmp/claude-0/-srv-leakruns-8dab1848f9d0-t1-ws/3f71dd0e-45c8-4cc8-9a23-10d40d503f14/scratchpad && cd /srv/leakruns/8dab1848f9d0-t1/ws/data && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
p=pd.read_csv('patients.csv.gz'); a=pd.read_csv('admissions.csv.gz',parse_dates=['admit_time','discharge_time']); l=pd.read_csv('labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['collect_time','report_time'])
m=l.merge(a,on='admission_id')
print('before admit',(m.collect_time<m.admit_time).sum(),'after disch',(m.collect_time>m.discharge_time).sum(), 'report after disch',(m.report_time>m.discharge_time).sum())
los=(a.discharge_time-a.admit_time).dt.total_seconds()/3600
for o in [24,48,72,96,120,144,168]: print(o,'in hosp',(los>o).sum(),'in hosp thru tp+48',(los>=o+48).sum())
# age vs multi admissions span
a['yr']=a.admit_time.dt.year; s=a.groupby('patient_id').yr.agg(['min','max']); s=s.join(p.set_index('patient_id').age)
s['span']=s['max']-s['min']; print(s.span.describe()); print('possible minors', ((s.age - s.span)<18).sum())
# family sizes and admission patients
fam=p.family_id.notna(); print('pts with fam',fam.sum())
print(pd.crosstab(a.unit,a.discharge_status))
# labs per admission by unit
n=l[l.test=='creatinine'].groupby('admission_id').size(); a['ncr']=a.admission_id.map(n).fillna(0); a['los']=los; a['rate']=a.ncr/(a.los/24)
print(a.groupby('unit')[['ncr','rate','los']].mean())
print(pd.read_csv('orders.csv.gz').order_type.value_counts())
"
